DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Enabled.Name: Enable Save Jingle
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Enabled.Toolt: Play the music when the end-of-day shipping screen opens.
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Volume.Name: Sound Volume
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Volume.Toolti: Set the music volume from 0% to 100%. This stacks with the selected sound category's volume as well!
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Category.Name: Sound Category
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Category.Tool: Choose which of the game's audio categories the music belongs to. This will require restarting the game.
DylanJames.SaveJingle.GMCM.Note.Text: This page is for nerds. Only edit these settings if you know what they mean and would like to balance the mod for yourself. If you make a mistake, click on the text that says 'Default' at the bottom of the screen.
